text:
clare: FYI found a supply-chain webhook payload in our logs that includes a Vault-wrapped ciphertext. Header points to `projects/our-proj/locations/global/keyRings/sc-kr/cryptoKeys/sc-wrap/cryptoKeyVersions/4`. Payload was forwarded to an external tracker. Treat as possible credential exposure.

yonas: Thanks. Do we have a Decrypt audit entry? Any idea if it's prod or staging?

clare: Quick audit grep shows a single Decrypt at 2026-07-09T18:02:15Z by `partner-ci@partnercorp.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. The webhook timestamp is 18:07Z. Looks like they pulled ciphertext then forwarded it. Header suggests `secret/supplychain/integrations` but could be reused blob.

sec-bot: INC-2026-1407 created: "Supply-chain webhook pasted KMS-wrapped Vault blob". Assigned to @clare. Priority P2.

rachel: Immediate plan: 1) apply temporary deny for `partner-ci@partnercorp` on the `sc-wrap` cryptoKey, 2) snapshot KMS + Vault audit logs to our forensics dataset, 3) enumerate Vault paths under `secret/supplychain` and collect metadata only.

yonas: Rotation approach: try server-side rewrap if Cloud KMS supports it. If not, create a new key version and perform rewrap in an ephemeral hardened VM in our secure project (no persistent disk, logging disabled). Avoid materializing plaintext in long-term storage.

clare: I'll handle vendor notification and legal loop-in. Rachel 14 can you own the Vault side? Please run `vault kv list secret/supplychain` and pull metadata (no decrypt).

rachel: On it. Will not fetch plaintext. Plan steps: (a) list keys and identify entries referencing `sc-wrap`, (b) copy ciphertexts to a secure test project for rewrap experiments, (c) run rewrap staging-first, (d) push rotated ciphertexts back and tag `meta.rotated_by=eng-security meta.kms_version=5 meta.rotated_at=2026-07-09T19:00:00Z`.

yonas: Also rotate any Vault tokens or service accounts that have read access to `secret/supplychain`. Add a short grace period keeping old key version active for 10 minutes to allow retries, then revoke. Enable an alert to page eng-security on any Decrypt of `sc-wrap` by principals outside `our-proj`.

clare: Notifying partner via our secure channel now and telling them we will temporarily revoke the cross-project grant while we investigate. Legal copied. Updating thread with timeline. :white_check_mark:
